svg.title: Zig main versus Goose K1: runtime throughput

cc:Work.dc:title: Zig main versus Goose K1: runtime throughput
cc:Work.dc:description: Vertical bars with original Gnorp-inspired shard-haulers. Taller means faster. Main is 1.00x. Median paired K1/main throughput: integer 1.04/1.06, F32 1.10/0.92, generic integer 0.83/0.88, generic F32 0.28/0.24, generic pair 0.16/0.15 in default/optimizing-only V8. Whiskers show all five paired ratios, not confidence intervals. Synthetic kernels, not gdev.
